result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's an excellent all-rounder for managing invoices, expenses, GST, bank reconciliation and reporting.

However, the best choice depends on the type of business you run and whether you have employees.

## My top 5 accounting software picks

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

From approximately A\$37/month

- Easy to use and cloud-based.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- GST and BAS reporting.
- Great accountant and bookkeeper integration.
- Payroll available on eligible plans.
  
  [Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/au/)

(Best for payroll and inventory)

Plans from approximately A\$35/month

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features.
- Good inventory management.
- BAS and GST functionality.
- Suitable for businesses with employees.
  
  [Visit MYOB](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

  [Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

(Best affordable alternative)

- Australian-focused accounting.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.

- Optional payroll functionality.
  
  [Visit Reckon](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

| Small service business | Xero |
| Retail business | MYOB |
| Business with employees | MYOB or Xero |
| Construction/trades | Xero or MYOB |
| Online business | Xero |
| Very tight budget | Zoho Books or Reckon |
